    Fs.fsExt], bbolt.flock.spec) (hStat : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 :
    HasExt Fs.fsExt], os.File.Stat.spec) (hSize : os.fileStat.Size.spec) (hMZ : ∀ [inst :

    bbolt.DB.init.spec) (hGPS : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt
    Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.getPageSize.spec_own) (hMmap : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk]
    [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.mmapUnlocked.spec_own) (hLoad : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics
    Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.loadFreelist.spec_open) (hSync : ∀
    [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.hasSyncedFreelist.spec)
    (hFds : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt],
    bbolt.fdatasync.spec) (hBegin : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 :
    HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.Begin_err.spec) (hCommit : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 :
    Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.Tx.Commit_err.spec) (hClose : bbolt.DB.Close.spec)
    (hclose : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt],
    bbolt.DB.close.spec_owned) (hLogger : bbolt.DB.Logger.spec) (hOptStr :
    bbolt.Options.String.spec) (hModeStr : bbolt.fs.FileMode.String.spec) : bbolt.Open.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Open.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt] [ThreadBoundLe GF (2 ^ 29)]
    [ReceiptBoundLe GF (2 ^ 62)] (N : Namespace) (path : GoString) (mode : w32) (opts : Loc) (dq : DFrac)
    (o : bbolt.OptsM) (D : bbolt.Data) (R : Fs.Roots) (V : Fs.Hist),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗
            Fs.osInv ∗
              ⌜N ## Fs.osN⌝ ∗
                Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) R V ∗
                  bbolt.pathHolds R V path D ∗
                    bbolt.optsAt opts dq o ∗ ⌜o.ok⌝ ∗ (⌜o.logger = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ bbolt.boltLogger o.logger) -∗
          (▷
              ∀ db err,
                (bbolt.optsAt opts dq o ∗
                    ∃ V',
                      Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) R V' ∗
                        ⌜V' = V ∨ ∃ e, V' = V.push e⌝ ∗
                          ((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                              ∃ γ i,
                                ⌜γ.ns = N ∧ Fs.lookupH R V' path = some (Fs.Node.file i)⌝ ∗
                                  bbolt.isBolt db γ ∗ bbolt.boltState γ 1 D) ∨
                            ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal db, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP ((((intoVal (functions go_etcd_io.bbolt.Open [])) (intoVal path)) (intoVal mode)) (intoVal opts)) {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.open_lock [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N :
    Namespace) (γs : GName) (D : bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗ ghostVar
    γs (Qp.half 1) 0 ∗ bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D ⊢ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half
    1) D ∗ |={⊤}[⊤ \ ↑(bbolt.dpN N)]▷=> ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗ typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own
    (Qp.half 1))

theorem bbolt.wp_OpenFile_db [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (hOpenFile :
    os.OpenFile.spec) (hCreate : os.OpenFile.specCreate) (path : GoString) (perm : w32) (R :
    Fs.Roots) (V : Fs.Hist) (D : bbolt.Data) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, Fs.osInv ∗ Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) R V ∗
    bbolt.pathHolds R V path D -∗ (▷ ∀ f err, (∃ V', Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) R V' ∗ ⌜V' = V ∨ ∃ e,
    V' = V.push e⌝ ∗ ((∃ fd i, ⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ 0 ≤ BitVec.toInt fd ∧ Fs.lookupH R V' path =
    some (Fs.Node.file i)⌝ ∗ os.ownFile f fd path (DFrac.own 1) ∗ Fs.osFd fd (DFrac.own 1) { ino :=
    i, readable := true, writable := true } ∗ bbolt.openedF i D) ∨ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ f =
    null⌝) ∗ fmtErrorOkOrNil err) -∗ Φ (intoVal f, intoVal err)) -∗ WP ((((intoVal (functions
    os.OpenFile [])) (intoVal path)) (intoVal (W64 66))) (intoVal perm)) {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.boltTx.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (tx tx✝ :
    Loc) (e_tx : tx = tx✝) (γ γ✝ : bbolt.BoltName) (e_γ : γ = γ✝) (q q✝ : Qp) (e_q : q = q✝) (T T✝ :
    bbolt.TxView) (e_T : T = T✝) : bbolt.boltTx tx γ q T = bbolt.boltTx tx✝ γ✝ q✝ T✝

    bbolt.BoltName) (e_γ : γ = γ✝) (q q✝ : Qp) (e_q : q = q✝) (D D✝ : bbolt.Data) (e_D : D = D✝) :
    bbolt.boltState γ q D = bbolt.boltState γ✝ q✝ D✝

theorem bbolt.pathHolds.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (R R✝ :
    Fs.Roots) (e_R : R = R✝) (V V✝ : Fs.Hist) (e_V : V = V✝) (path path✝ : GoString) (e_path : path
    = path✝) (D D✝ : bbolt.Data) (e_D : D = D✝) : bbolt.pathHolds R V path D = bbolt.pathHolds R✝ V✝
    path✝ D✝

theorem bbolt.txDB.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (tx tx✝ : Loc)

theorem bbolt.open_unlock [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N
    : Namespace) (γs : GName) (D : bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗
    ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗ typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half 1) D ⊢
    |={⊤}=> typedPointsto dp db DFrac.discard ∗ bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D
